en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5244 - Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad narrated from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah from Abu Baṣir from Abu Abdullah (as) who said:
"A father is not executed for killing his son, but a son is executed for killing his father."
Imam (as) also said: "Two men who kill one another do not inherit from each other."
